text.text_excerpt: Solid choice for neighborhood sushi. It's in a strip mall so ambiance isn't amazing but it's clean and the tables are well spaced. We had great service the night I was there. The drink menu is interesting but I stuck to tea, but my friends enjoyed their cocktails. Many of their specialty rolls come with either eel sauce or spicy mayo. I'm not a fan of either so I just ask for no sauce and they were happy to accommodate. The fish was really good quality the night I was there. And the veggie roll was tasty (always my palate cleanser). I did not see any hibachi action happening the night I was there, so I can't say anything about that. Solid neighborhood choice and I'll be back when I'm out ...

I like this place. The sushi rolls are always fresh and yummy! Delivery is a plus. They are a very skimpy on the appetizers, though comparing to other similar places, so we learned to just order the meal size. I like that the rolls are cut into 8 pieces and my favorite is the tempura shrimp rolls! No one has that on their menus! So good! Don't know about table service, we always do take out or delivery and never had a problem with our order.

I've only been there once, and the sushi was delicious. In my limited experience I usually hold off on reviewing a place, but I'm going to give it five stars because it's a new business and they could use the visibility! I haven't tried any of their specialty rolls. I went real simple the first time: had the fresh salmon box and the unagi (eel) nigirizushi. They were both delicious, the eel barbecued nicely, the salmon fresh and the crab salad tasty and sweet. The salmon box pieces also had a slice of avocado on top, which is a nice complement that not every restaurant has.
